id: title:jonmcwest:send hog flow logs to the logs product

review.posthog_relevance: Adds dependency and configuration support for the HogFunctionMonitoringService to consume internal logs, establishing the architectural boundary for this capability.
review.reason: Adds the dependency and configuration type for an internal logs producer, establishing the mechanism for HogFunctionMonitoringService to consume internal logs. This is a substantive, bounded implementation of a new capability.

observations.behavior: Adds import for InternalLogsProducer and InternalLogsProducerConfig.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes a dependency on an internal logs producer, suggesting the service will now consume or produce internal logs.

observations.behavior: Adds CDP_INTERNAL_LOGS_SOURCES to the configuration type.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines a configuration key for specifying which log sources should be sent to the internal logs product.

observations.behavior: Merges InternalLogsProducerConfig into CdpCoreServicesConfig and instantiates InternalLogsProducer if configured.
